Our friends from other teams agreed to have bundles with Wild Legion!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement - January 26th
notes.notes:
Last month, we changed many things mentioned to us by GRound beta testers. Some content was already implemented in the demo; some content will be revealed later this week.

Changes already implemented
New Music
 New longer Lounge Menu Music
 5 New Music Tracks inside the game
We tried to find pleasant, cozy retro game music with permission to stream on YouTube and Twitch. Each time you start the game, a new music track will play. We hope you like it as much as we did.
Total UI Overhaul
Liya and Erabit created new home screen and UI background images. We re-assigned the buttons and toggled the colors a bit. Here is Before and After:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/e6e89f42fe2ceae0060510272f70a85ee7033071.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/717a69169ac264f8e7b9345a19a1d915bb0bf1e4.png

90+ Achievements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800848/3f9cd035880508779a3a230e9455929143ce0878.png
Currently, there are 56 Achievements in the testing.
We want players to explore the game on their own, without pesky tutorial pop-ups obstructing their journey. This is a simple, survival-like game. The Achievements would guide you to explore all content if you desire to do so.
Hints on upcoming content

 More animals
 More night siege maps
 Modding support

More in the content roadmap soon...

[previewyoutube=HnIGiRcwGJo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: First Mini Update after GRound's reviews
notes.notes:
Hey good people! 

Thank you for playing our game and taking the time to write such descriptive reviews. We did expect to get many criticisms, but all the reviews were really kind. Your will to help us touched the hearts of each of us five :)

We managed to do a small update over this weekend:
1) French and other languages’ localization got updated
2) Added a 4K high-resolution mode
3) Added “auto-aiming” and “auto-building” check-boxes to the pause settings
4) Fixed the UI a bit to improve readability (we hope you'll like it)
 
P.S. We have finished the giveaway, and one GRound player has already bought Lego Brawls with the cash won!
P.S.S. Hope you can take part in the GRound’s survey soon!

Thank you <3
BluSped team
